items.title: Raymond James Attracts Two Teams Totaling $1.75B
items.summary: Two teams are joining the firm's employee and independent channels. The latter is the latest team to join Raymond James from Commonwealth, following LPL’s acquisition of the broker/dealer.

items.title: LPL Financial Recruits Advisors With More Than $1.4 Billion in Assets
items.summary: BEST PRACTICES  LPL Financial’s recruiting efforts netted it several financial advisors who collectively oversaw more than $1.4 billion in client assets at Raymond James Financial and Northwestern Mutual, the company says.

items.title: 3 US Broker Stocks Where Higher Rates Could Lift Interest Income
items.summary: Interest rates are rising again, inflation is still sticky, and suddenly the sleepy corner of brokerage cash and margin lending looks anything but boring. When the Fed pushes the benchmark rate to a range of 3.75% to 4%, every idle dollar in a brokerage account and every margin loan starts to matter more to investors and to the brokers themselves. items.title: Meta’s Muse AI Agent Triggers Worries About Brokerage Stocks
items.summary: Concerns about AI have repeatedly sparked selloffs of shares of brokerage firms. On Tuesday, Meta’s Muse AI agent became the latest catalyst.

items.title: WEX, Raymond James, Sallie Mae, Voya Financial, and Charles Schwab Shares Plummet, What You Need To Know
items.summary: A number of stocks fell in the afternoon session after investors kept bidding the group lower after last week’s Federal Reserve hike. On September 16, the Fed raised the federal funds target range by 25 basis points to 3.75%–4.00%, its first increase since 2023, according to the Federal Reserve’s FOMC statement. items.title: 3 Market-Beating Stocks Worth Investigating
items.summary: Stocks that outperform the market usually share key traits such as rising sales, expanding margins, and increasing returns on capital. The select few that can do all three for many years are often the ones that make you life-changing money.
